# Same-Day Delivery: How Brick-and-Mortar Retailers Can Compete With Amazon


For years, e-commerce giants like Amazon have dominated markets traditionally held by brick-and-mortar retailers (B&Ms). Their ability to offer same-day and next-day delivery—sometimes within just a few hours—has reshaped customer expectations.


How do they achieve it? Through strategically placed warehouses close to customers and streamlined logistics.


## Here’s What the Data Tells Us About Rapid Delivery


Same-day delivery is no longer a perk; it’s a must-have feature for consumers. Here are key findings:


### 1.[Delivery trend reports](https://eliteextra.com/the-growing-importance-of-same-day-delivery-5-trends-and-statistics-to-watch/) show:


- Over 50% of consumers say same-day delivery influenced their switch from physical stores to online shopping.
- 56% of millennials expect same-day or next-day delivery by default.
- 25% of shoppers abandon carts if delivery takes longer than 24 hours.
- 61% of customers are willing to pay more for faster delivery.


### 2.[A survey of 1,013 shoppers](https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2024/09/13/free-and-fast-shipping-consumers-delivery-2024/#:~:text=Breaking%20down%20delivery%20speed%2C%20about,sourcing%20or%20using%20electric%20vehicles.) reveals:


- 68% of consumers care as much about delivery speed as free shipping.
- 52% of shoppers expect next-day delivery as a standard service.
- 42% of customers choose Amazon because of its same-day option.


Even hybrid retailers like Target, Best Buy, and Home Depot have adopted same-day models to stay relevant. For customers today, fast delivery is non-negotiable.


## How Can Brick-and-Mortar Retailers Compete?


Brick-and-mortar retailers hold a key advantage: they are already close to their customers. This proximity makes same-day delivery possible, and with the right logistics partner, they can expand their reach to attract new customers through platforms like Google (and[Google Shopping](https://www.google.com/shopping) ).


However, managing same-day delivery can be tricky and costly without the right infrastructure. This is where Getcho comes in. We simplify last-mile logistics, ensuring reliable and secure deliveries so retailers can focus on sales, not operations.
